heading: Expressions — comparison operators
text:
### Expressions — comparison operators [LNLS.4.2]

Overlays [LEXP.1.1] (operator table) and [LEXP.2.1] (comparison chains).

Comparison operators `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=` remain legal in:
- Single-pattern `where` clauses on String slots with `capacity`.
- Single-pattern `where` clauses on numeric slots (unrestricted).
- RHS action argument expressions (not join tests; no restriction).

Comparison operators `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=` become a compile error in:
- Cross-pattern `where` clauses on String-typed bindings (LNLS.3.8).
